Workbook & review workflow: This workbook matches the shared frontend and Apps Script backend. Source cells are preserved; the inactive Exam sheet is hidden.

Tasks use title, description, assignees, status and due date. Meetings use title, date, participants, link/location and attendance logging. Courses use title, course link and assigned members, with optional track, requirement and deadline settings.

Update task status using the Kanban drag-and-drop board or the status dropdown. There is no task completion form. Completed status counts for all assignees; moving back to an open status reverses that progress.
Uncompleted > Pending > Completed. Evidence is optional. Members can submit without a file, or attach a PDF, PNG or JPEG up to 10 MB. Only an admin approval counts toward progress.

New events appear as saving drafts immediately while the app stays usable. Event saves shows confirmation or a retry action. Unconfirmed drafts do not count in progress. Retries reuse the same event ID to prevent duplicates.

Task assignees and admins add completion or issue links directly on the task card. Evidence Links is an app-managed field on Task that retains author, time, purpose, note and removed-link history. Adding a link never changes board status.

Activity includes user submissions, approvals, task evidence, settings changes and authenticated request failures. Use member/category/search filters and open details to investigate errors or request IDs. Completion retains the individual review records.
An admin opens Logging Enabled. Members submit attendance for review; evidence is optional. Only approved attendance counts toward progress.

Members can withdraw Pending or undo Completed records from their event card, including imported completions. Status returns to Uncompleted. Resubmission creates a new attempt and requires review again.
Admins use the review queue in Learning or Meetings. Approve sets Completed; Return sets Uncompleted and requires feedback. Withdrawn or superseded submissions cannot be approved.

Each row is a submission attempt. Submission ID is stable. Status, reviewer, review time, review note, last status change and actor are saved. Older attempts and attachments remain as history; the latest attempt is authoritative.

Apps Script stores files in the submitting account's private ASAR evidence folder, shares each file with currently enabled admins, and writes its Drive ID, URL, name, type and size to Completion. Do not paste file bytes into cells.
Imported Log totals and existing Completion rows with blank Status remain accepted historical records. No reviewer or evidence is invented. A member undo overrides their imported completion.
Use the web app to review or undo so Log aggregates and Activity history remain synchronized. Direct manual status edits are reflected by the app but do not create an authenticated review audit.

Lookups lists current members, admins, event keys, skills and allowed values. Completion Name, Email and Event Name contain lookup formulas for manual entry. Open in Excel or Google Sheets to calculate formulas.

Source event sheets define events. Invited/Assigned and Assignees accept exact names on separate lines. Team ID is the stable key. Admins is the only permission list; Role alone never grants admin access.

The Skills page contains per-member required skills only. SkillRequirements uses Member ID, Skill, Category, TRUE/FALSE and optional Target Score (0-10). Without overrides, members inherit their recorded Team entries. Prior standalone assessments are archived; SkillEvents is hidden as historical data.

Team Intelligence shows Technology, Skills, Knowledge, Abilities and Personality lists below the overview. Knowledge and Skills accept plain text lines or JSON arrays of category/items groups. Recorded Hard Skill and Soft Skill ratings also appear in Skills. Empty values stay empty.

Older durations, task scores/feedback, track IDs, related skills, platform and meeting-type columns are preserved but hidden. New forms and saves use the essential fields only. Stable IDs, archive flags and review metadata remain operational fields.

Subteams defines Subteam ID, Name, Description, Color and Active. TeamMemberships assigns Member ID and a Leader, Member or Support role per subteam. Each subteam needs one or more leaders; people can belong to multiple subteams. One overall Team Leader remains in Team.

Use Edit distribution in Team hierarchy to create/rename/remove subteams and assign all members. Global Leader roles, Department and Reports To are compatibility summaries; normalized membership rows store every relationship. Removed rows are disabled, never deleted.

New members use the ASAR Team Application Google Form linked from the hub. The form-bound script in forms/TeamApplications.gs updates profile fields by header and preserves roles, permissions and removal state. Admins remove members in Team Intelligence: Team Active becomes FALSE and memberships are disabled; records remain. Transfer sole leadership first. Restore via the Team Active flag and Edit distribution when needed.

Task moves, completion submissions, reviews, edits, required skills and distribution changes update the UI immediately and save in the background. Pending changes show Saving changes. Failures roll back unconfirmed changes and keep Retry update available in Event saves. CV exports use confirmed data.

Members can use Update result or Reset skill directly on their own skill card. Updates preserve prior results. Reset clears completion and removes that assessment from current ratings; original Team sheet ratings and history remain intact. Re-completion adds a fresh assessment.
Meet Date is the scheduled date. Due to Date is the deadline through that date in Africa/Cairo. Members may undo even after a deadline; an admin must reopen a closed event before resubmission.

Import this workbook into Google Sheets, install generated Code.gs and Index.html, use Africa/Cairo and execute as the accessing signed-in user. Allow Drive authorization. Each user needs sheet write access. Adding a future admin may require sharing older evidence with them.

The local app keeps uploads as session-only files and provides download links. Local URLs are not persistent Drive evidence; deploy Apps Script for durable uploads. Export CSVs before reloading local data.
Run python tools/style_workbook.py after changing the source schema or roster to refresh lookups and the delivery workbook. This also rebuilds CSVs and both app interfaces.
